description: This file defines the AggregateException class, which extends RejectionException, used for representing exceptions in promise handling within the GuzzleHttp Promises library.

classes.name: AggregateException
classes.description: An exception class used to indicate multiple errors occurring during promise operations such as some() or any().

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and reasons array, and sets up the rejection message with the count of rejected promises.
